<![CDATA[import type { Metadata } from "next";
import { Bodoni_Moda, Hanken_Grotesk, Spline_Sans_Mono } from "next/font/google";
import "./verane/verane.css";

const display = Bodoni_Moda({
  subsets: ["latin"],
  style: ["normal", "italic"],
  variable: "--font-bodoni-moda",
});

const body = Hanken_Grotesk({
  subsets: ["latin"],
  variable: "--font-hanken-grotesk",
});

const mono = Spline_Sans_Mono({
  subsets: ["latin"],
  preload: false,
  variable: "--font-spline-mono",
});

export const metadata: Metadata = {
  title: "Maison Vérane — Composed slowly. Worn for hours.",
  description:
    "A Grasse perfume house that composes four fragrances a year. Every perfume unfolds across twelve hours on skin.",
};

export default function VeraneLayout({ children }: { children: React.ReactNode }) {
  return (
    <html lang="en" className={`${display.variable} ${body.variable} ${mono.variable}`}>
      <body className="vr-body">{children}</body>
    </html>
  );
}

<![CDATA[import { ASSETS } from "./assets.generated";

const BASE = "/templates/verane";

/** URL for a processed image, or null when not yet generated. */
export function assetSrc(
  key: string,
  width: 800 | 1600,
  format: "webp" | "avif" = "webp",
): string | null {
  return key in ASSETS ? `${BASE}/${key}-${width}.${format}` : null;
}

export type PictureProps = {
  assetKey: string;
  alt: string;
  className?: string;
  sizes?: string;
  priority?: boolean;
  aspectRatio?: string;
  dark?: boolean;
};

/**
 * A responsive <picture>, or a styled placeholder block labeled with its assetKey.
 */
export function Picture({
  assetKey,
  alt,
  className,
  sizes = "(min-width: 1024px) 50vw, 100vw",
  priority,
  aspectRatio,
  dark,
}: PictureProps) {
  const webp800 = assetSrc(assetKey, 800);
  if (!webp800) {
    return (
      <div
        className={`vr-placeholder ${dark ? "vr-placeholder--dark" : ""} ${className ?? ""}`}
        style={aspectRatio ? { aspectRatio } : undefined}
        role="img"
        aria-label={alt}
        data-asset={assetKey}
      >
        <span className="vr-mono">{assetKey}</span>
        <span style={{ fontSize: "0.8rem", opacity: 0.75 }}>{alt}</span>
      </div>
    );
  }

  const { w, h } = ASSETS[assetKey];
  const set = (format: "webp" | "avif") =>
    `${assetSrc(assetKey, 800, format)} 800w, ${assetSrc(assetKey, 1600, format)} 1600w`;

  return (
    <picture className={className} style={aspectRatio ? { aspectRatio } : undefined}>
      <source type="image/avif" srcSet={set("avif")} sizes={sizes} />
      <img
        src={webp800}
        srcSet={set("webp")}
        sizes={sizes}
        width={w}
        height={h}
        alt={alt}
        loading={priority ? "eager" : "lazy"}
        fetchPriority={priority ? "high" : undefined}
        decoding="async"
        data-asset={assetKey}
        style={{ width: "100%", height: "100%", objectFit: "cover" }}
      />
    </picture>
  );
}
]]>

<![CDATA[import { ClockProvider } from "./drydown/ClockProvider";

    <ClockProvider initialHour={0} initialFragrance="iris-calcaire">
      <Header />
      <main id="top">
        <Hero />
        <DryDownSection />
        <Hours />
        <OrganSection />
        <Atelier />
        <Appointments />
      </main>
      <Footer />

  );
}

<![CDATA[@import "tailwindcss";

/* ─────────────── MAISON VÉRANE tokens: Grasse haute parfumerie ─────────────── */
@theme {
  --color-oud: #2A1E22;
  --color-calcaire: #E3DFD8;
  --color-orris: #655A7E;
  --color-gilt: #B59A6A;
  --color-veil: #CFC9C0;
  --color-ash: #5F5753;

  --font-display: var(--font-bodoni-moda), Didot, "Times New Roman", serif;
  --font-body: var(--font-hanken-grotesk), ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif;
  --font-mono: var(--font-spline-mono), ui-monospace, Menlo, monospace;

  --ease-out: cubic-bezier(0.23, 1, 0.32, 1);
  --ease-drain: cubic-bezier(0.33, 0, 0.2, 1);
}

.vr-body {
  --topbar-h: 68px;
  --gutter: clamp(20px, 4.5vw, 72px);
  --wrap-max: 1320px;
  --rule-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-ash) 35%, transparent);

  margin: 0;
  background-color: var(--color-calcaire);
  color: var(--color-oud);
  font-family: var(--font-body);
  font-size: 1.0625rem;
  line-height: 1.6;
  -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased;
}

html:has(.vr-body) {
  scroll-padding-top: var(--topbar-h);
}

@media (prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference) {
  html:has(.vr-body) {
    scroll-behavior: smooth;
  }
}

.vr-body ::selection {
  background: var(--color-orris);
  color: var(--color-calcaire);
}

.vr-body :focus-visible {
  outline: 2px solid var(--color-orris);
  outline-offset: 3px;
}

.vr-dark :focus-visible {
  outline: 2px solid var(--color-gilt);
  outline-offset: 3px;
}

[hidden] {
  display: none !important;
}

.vr-vh {
  position: absolute;
  width: 1px;
  height: 1px;
  overflow: hidden;
  clip-path: inset(50%);
  white-space: nowrap;
}

/* ─────────────── Typography & Utility ─────────────── */
.vr-serif {
  font-family: var(--font-display);
}

.vr-mono {
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: 0.75rem;
  letter-spacing: 0.12em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
}

.vr-wrap {
  width: 100%;
  max-width: var(--wrap-max);
  margin-left: auto;
  margin-right: auto;
  padding-left: var(--gutter);
  padding-right: var(--gutter);
}

/* ─────────────── Buttons ─────────────── */
.vr-btn {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  gap: 0.6rem;
  height: 48px;
  padding: 0 1.75rem;
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: 0.75rem;
  letter-spacing: 0.12em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  font-weight: 500;
  text-decoration: none;
  cursor: pointer;
  border-radius: 9999px;
  transition: transform 180ms var(--ease-out), background-color 200ms var(--ease-out), color 200ms var(--ease-out), border-color 200ms var(--ease-out);
}

.vr-btn:active {
  transform: scale(0.97);
}

.vr-btn--orris {
  background-color: var(--color-orris);
  color: var(--color-calcaire);
  border: 1px solid var(--color-orris);
}

@media (hover: hover) and (pointer: fine) {
  .vr-btn--orris:hover {
    background-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-orris) 85%, var(--color-oud));
    border-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-orris) 85%, var(--color-oud));
  }
}

.vr-btn--outline {
  background-color: transparent;
  color: var(--color-oud);
  border: 1px solid currentColor;
}

@media (hover: hover) and (pointer: fine) {
  .vr-btn--outline:hover {
    background-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-oud) 8%, transparent);
  }
}

.vr-btn--outline-dark {
  background-color: transparent;
  color: var(--color-calcaire);
  border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-calcaire) 40%, transparent);
}

@media (hover: hover) and (pointer: fine) {
  .vr-btn--outline-dark:hover {
    border-color: var(--color-gilt);
    color: var(--color-gilt);
  }
}

/* ─────────────── Eyebrow Section Header ─────────────── */
.vr-eyebrow {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 1.25rem;
  margin-bottom: 2rem;
}

.vr-eyebrow__rule {
  width: 36px;
  height: 1px;
  background-color: currentColor;
  opacity: 0.5;
}

/* ─────────────── Placeholder Art Box ─────────────── */
.vr-placeholder {
  position: relative;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  gap: 0.5rem;
  background-color: var(--color-veil);
  color: var(--color-ash);
  border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-ash) 25%, transparent);
  border-radius: inherit;
  min-height: 240px;
  padding: 1.5rem;
  text-align: center;
  overflow: hidden;
}

.vr-placeholder::before {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  background-image: repeating-linear-gradient(
    45deg,
    color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-ash) 8%, transparent) 0,
    color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-ash) 8%, transparent) 1px,
    transparent 0,
    transparent 16px
  );
  pointer-events: none;
}

.vr-placeholder--dark {
  background-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-oud) 95%, var(--color-ash));
  color: var(--color-veil);
  border-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-ash) 35%, transparent);
}

/* ─────────────── Hero Section ─────────────── */
.vr-hero {
  position: relative;
  isolation: isolate;
  min-height: clamp(600px, 92svh, 920px);
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  justify-content: flex-end;
  color: var(--color-calcaire);
  background-color: var(--color-oud);
  overflow: hidden;
  padding-bottom: clamp(3rem, 7vw, 6rem);
}

.vr-hero__bg {
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  z-index: -2;
}

.vr-hero__bg img,
.vr-hero__bg .vr-placeholder,
.vr-hero__bg svg {
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
  object-fit: cover;
  object-position: center right;
  transition: transform 1.6s var(--ease-out);
}

@media (prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference) {
  .vr-hero__bg img,
  .vr-hero__bg svg {
    animation: vrHeroSettle 1.6s var(--ease-out) forwards;
  }
}

@keyframes vrHeroSettle {
  from {
    transform: scale(1.04);
  }
  to {
    transform: scale(1);
  }
}

/* Scrim: Oud gradient from left guarantees WCAG text contrast */
.vr-hero::before {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  z-index: -1;
  background: linear-gradient(
    90deg,
    color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-oud) 94%, transparent) 0%,
    color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-oud) 85%, transparent) 40%,
    color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-oud) 35%, transparent) 75%,
    transparent 100%
  ),
  linear-gradient(
    0deg,
    color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-oud) 75%, transparent) 0%,
    transparent 45%
  );
}

@media (max-width: 640px) {
  .vr-hero {
    min-height: 0;
    padding-top: clamp(240px, 60vw, 360px);
    justify-content: flex-start;
  }
  .vr-hero::before {
    background: linear-gradient(
      0deg,
      var(--color-oud) 0%,
      var(--color-oud) 60%,
      color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-oud) 30%, transparent) 85%,
      transparent 100%
    );
  }
}

/* ─────────────── DryDown Scrubber & Pinned Stage ─────────────── */
.vr-drydown-outer {
  position: relative;
  background-color: var(--color-oud);
  color: var(--color-calcaire);
}

/* Desktop pinned mode */
.vr-drydown-outer[data-mode="pinned"] {
  height: 340svh;
}

.vr-drydown-stage {
  position: sticky;
  top: 0;
  height: 100svh;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  justify-content: space-between;
  padding: calc(var(--topbar-h) + 1rem) var(--gutter) 2.5rem;
  max-width: var(--wrap-max);
  margin: 0 auto;
}

/* Flow mode on mobile or reduced motion */
.vr-drydown-outer[data-mode="flow"] .vr-drydown-stage {
  position: relative;
  top: auto;
  height: auto;
  padding: 5rem var(--gutter) 6rem;
}

.vr-flacon-glass {
  border: 1.5px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-calcaire) 40%, transparent);
  background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-calcaire) 5%, transparent);
  border-radius: 0.75rem;
  position: relative;
  overflow: hidden;
}

.vr-flacon-band {
  transform-origin: bottom center;
  transition: transform 220ms var(--ease-drain), opacity 220ms var(--ease-drain);
}

@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  .vr-flacon-band {
    transition: none !important;
  }
}

.vr-note-item {
  transition: opacity 220ms var(--ease-drain);
}

.vr-note-item[data-state="gone"] {
  opacity: 0.35;
  text-decoration: line-through;
}

.vr-note-item[data-state="fading"] {
  opacity: 0.7;
}

.vr-note-item[data-state="present"] {
  opacity: 1;
}

.vr-note-item[data-state="emerging"] {
  opacity: 0.85;
}

/* ─────────────── Range Scrubber Input ─────────────── */
.vr-range {
  -webkit-appearance: none;
  appearance: none;
  width: 100%;
  height: 6px;
  background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-ash) 35%, transparent);
  outline: none;
  border-radius: 0;
  cursor: ew-resize;
  margin: 1.5rem 0 0.5rem;
}

.vr-range:focus-visible {
  outline: 2px solid var(--color-orris);
  outline-offset: 4px;
}

.vr-range::-webkit-slider-thumb {
  -webkit-appearance: none;
  appearance: none;
  width: 22px;
  height: 22px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: var(--color-orris);
  border: 2px solid var(--color-calcaire);
  cursor: grab;
  box-shadow: 0 2px 8px color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-oud) 50%, transparent);
  transition: transform 120ms var(--ease-out);
}

.vr-range::-moz-range-thumb {
  width: 22px;
  height: 22px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: var(--color-orris);
  border: 2px solid var(--color-calcaire);
  cursor: grab;
  box-shadow: 0 2px 8px color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-oud) 50%, transparent);
  transition: transform 120ms var(--ease-out);
}

.vr-range:active::-webkit-slider-thumb {
  cursor: grabbing;
  transform: scale(1.15);
}

.vr-range:active::-moz-range-thumb {
  cursor: grabbing;
  transform: scale(1.15);
}

/* ─────────────── Card Grid & Stamps ─────────────── */
.vr-card {
  background-color: var(--color-calcaire);
  color: var(--color-oud);
  border: 1px solid var(--rule-color);
  border-radius: 1.25rem;
  padding: clamp(1.75rem, 3.5vw, 2.75rem);
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  justify-content: space-between;
  transition: border-color 200ms var(--ease-out);
}

.vr-stamp {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  padding: 4px 10px;
  border: 1px solid var(--color-orris);
  color: var(--color-orris);
  border-radius: 0.375rem;
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: 0.6875rem;
  letter-spacing: 0.14em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
}

.vr-stamp--gilt {
  border-color: var(--color-gilt);
  color: var(--color-gilt);
}

/* ─────────────── Organ Composer ─────────────── */
.vr-organ-vial {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: center;
  padding: 0.875rem 0.5rem;
  border: 1px solid var(--rule-color);
  border-radius: 0.875rem;
  background: transparent;
  color: inherit;
  cursor: pointer;
  text-align: center;
  transition: background-color 160ms var(--ease-out), border-color 160ms var(--ease-out);
}

.vr-organ-vial[aria-checked="true"] {
  background-color: var(--color-orris);
  color: var(--color-calcaire);
  border-color: var(--color-orris);
}

@media (hover: hover) and (pointer: fine) {
  .vr-organ-vial:not([aria-checked="true"]):hover {
    background-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-veil) 60%, transparent);
    border-color: var(--color-ash);
  }
}

    <file path="src/app/(verane)/verane/brand/Logo.tsx">
<![CDATA[import type { SVGProps } from "react";

interface LogoMarkProps extends SVGProps<SVGSVGElement> {
  size?: number;
  topLevel?: number; // 0 to 1
  heartLevel?: number; // 0 to 1
  baseLevel?: number; // 0 to 1
}

/**
 * Maison Vérane Mark: A stylized perfume drop divided into the three evaporation tiers:
 * Top (evaporates early), Heart (mid layer), and Base (resins/woods that hold to skin).
 * When levels are passed (0..1), the liquid bands scale/drain with the shared dry-down clock.
 */
export function LogoMark({
  size = 32,
  topLevel = 0,
  heartLevel = 0.55,
  baseLevel = 1,
  className,
  ...props
}: LogoMarkProps) {
  // Height allocation in the 64x64 viewBox:
  // Top band: y=20..33 (h=13)
  // Heart band: y=33..45 (h=12)
  // Base band: y=45..60 (h=15)
  return (
    <svg
      viewBox="0 0 64 64"
      width={size}
      height={size}
      role="img"
      aria-label="Maison Vérane drop mark"
      className={className}
      {...props}
    >
      <defs>
        <clipPath id="vr-drop-clip">
          <path d="M32 5C26 14 13 28 13 40a19 19 0 0 0 38 0C51 28 38 14 32 5Z" />
        </clipPath>
      </defs>

      {/* Internal liquid layers, clipped inside the flacon drop */}
      <g clipPath="url(#vr-drop-clip)">
        {/* Top band */}
        {topLevel > 0 && (
          <rect
            x="0"
            y={33 - 13 * topLevel}
            width="64"
            height={13 * topLevel}
            fill="currentColor"
            opacity={0.2}
          />
        )}
        {/* Heart band */}
        {heartLevel > 0 && (
          <rect
            x="0"
            y={45 - 12 * heartLevel}
            width="64"
            height={12 * heartLevel}
            fill="currentColor"
            opacity={0.45}
          />
        )}
        {/* Base band */}
        {baseLevel > 0 && (
          <rect
            x="0"
            y={60 - 15 * baseLevel}
            width="64"
            height={15 * baseLevel}
            fill="currentColor"
            opacity={0.9}
          />
        )}
      </g>

      {/* Flacon outline */}
      <path
        d="M32 5C26 14 13 28 13 40a19 19 0 0 0 38 0C51 28 38 14 32 5Z"
        fill="none"
        stroke="currentColor"
        strokeWidth={size <= 24 ? "5" : "3.5"}
        strokeLinejoin="round"
      />
    </svg>
  );
}

interface LogoProps extends SVGProps<SVGSVGElement> {
  width?: number;
  height?: number;
  topLevel?: number;
  heartLevel?: number;
  baseLevel?: number;
}

/** Full typographic lockup: Mark + MAISON VÉRANE */
export function Logo({
  width = 240,
  height = 56,
  topLevel,
  heartLevel,
  baseLevel,
  className,
  ...props
}: LogoProps) {
  return (
    <svg
      viewBox="0 0 380 96"
      width={width}
      height={height}
      role="img"
      aria-label="Maison Vérane"
      className={className}
      {...props}
    >
      <g transform="translate(0, 14)">
        <LogoMark
          size={68}
          topLevel={topLevel}
          heartLevel={heartLevel}
          baseLevel={baseLevel}
          aria-hidden="true"
        />
      </g>
      <text
        x="96"
        y="32"
        fill="currentColor"
        fontFamily="var(--font-spline-mono), monospace"
        fontSize="11"
        letterSpacing="6"
      >
        MAISON
      </text>
      <text
        x="93"
        y="76"
        fill="currentColor"
        fontFamily="var(--font-bodoni-moda), serif"
        fontSize="44"
        letterSpacing="8"
      >
        VÉRANE
      </text>
    </svg>
  );
}

<![CDATA[export interface ClockState {
  hour: number;
  fragranceSlug: string;
}

export interface ClockStore {
  getState: () => ClockState;
  setHour: (hour: number) => void;
  setFragranceSlug: (slug: string) => void;
  subscribe: (listener: () => void) => () => void;
}

const DEFAULT_STATE: ClockState = {
  hour: 0,
  fragranceSlug: "iris-calcaire",
};

/** Creates an observable clock store compatible with React's useSyncExternalStore. */
export function createClockStore(initial?: Partial<ClockState>): ClockStore {
  let state: ClockState = {
    hour: initial?.hour ?? DEFAULT_STATE.hour,
    fragranceSlug: initial?.fragranceSlug ?? DEFAULT_STATE.fragranceSlug,
  };

  const listeners = new Set<() => void>();

  function notify() {
    for (const listener of listeners) {
      listener();
    }
  }

  return {
    getState: () => state,
    setHour: (nextHour: number) => {
      const clamped = Math.max(0, Math.min(12, Math.round(nextHour * 100) / 100));
      if (clamped === state.hour) return;
      state = { ...state, hour: clamped };
      notify();
    },
    setFragranceSlug: (nextSlug: string) => {
      if (nextSlug === state.fragranceSlug) return;
      state = { ...state, fragranceSlug: nextSlug };
      notify();
    },
    subscribe: (listener: () => void) => {
      listeners.add(listener);
      return () => {
        listeners.delete(listener);
      };
    },
  };
}
]]>

<![CDATA[export type ClockStep =
  | "next15"
  | "prev15"
  | "nextHour"
  | "prevHour"
  | "start"
  | "end";

/** Format a decimal hour (0..12) into "H HH:MM" format. */
export function formatHour(hour: number): string {
  const clamped = Math.max(0, Math.min(12, hour));
  const totalMinutes = Math.round(clamped * 60);
  const h = Math.floor(totalMinutes / 60);
  const m = totalMinutes % 60;
  const padH = h.toString().padStart(2, "0");
  const padM = m.toString().padStart(2, "0");
  return `H ${padH}:${padM}`;
}

/**
 * Progress (0..1) -> Hour (0..12)
 * Quadratic curve: hour = 12 * progress^2
 * Gives top notes (first 45 min) the first 25% of scroll travel.
 */
export function progressToHour(progress: number): number {
  const p = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, progress));
  return 12 * (p * p);
}

/**
 * Hour (0..12) -> Progress (0..1)
 * Inverted quadratic: progress = sqrt(hour / 12)
 */
export function hourToProgress(hour: number): number {
  const h = Math.max(0, Math.min(12, hour));
  return Math.sqrt(h / 12);
}

/** Compute updated hour when stepped via keyboard / buttons. */
export function stepHour(currentHour: number, step: ClockStep): number {
  let next = currentHour;
  switch (step) {
    case "next15":
      next = currentHour + 0.25;
      break;
    case "prev15":
      next = currentHour - 0.25;
      break;
    case "nextHour":
      next = currentHour + 1;
      break;
    case "prevHour":
      next = currentHour - 1;
      break;
    case "start":
      next = 0;
      break;
    case "end":
      next = 12;
      break;
  }
  return Math.max(0, Math.min(12, Math.round(next * 100) / 100));
}

<![CDATA["use client";

import {
  createContext,
  useContext,
  useMemo,
  useSyncExternalStore,
  type ReactNode,
} from "react";
import { createClockStore, type ClockStore, type ClockState } from "./clock-store";
import { FRAGRANCES, getFragranceBySlug, type Fragrance } from "../content/fragrances";

interface ClockContextValue {
  hour: number;
  fragranceSlug: string;
  activeFragrance: Fragrance;
  setHour: (hour: number) => void;
  setFragranceSlug: (slug: string) => void;
  store: ClockStore;
}

const ClockContext = createContext<ClockStore | null>(null);

export function ClockProvider({
  children,
  initialHour = 0,
  initialFragrance = "iris-calcaire",
}: {
  children: ReactNode;
  initialHour?: number;
  initialFragrance?: string;
}) {
  const store = useMemo(
    () =>
      createClockStore({
        hour: initialHour,
        fragranceSlug: initialFragrance,
      }),
    [initialHour, initialFragrance],
  );

  return <ClockContext.Provider value={store}>{children}</ClockContext.Provider>;
}

export function useClock(): ClockContextValue {
  const store = useContext(ClockContext);
  if (!store) {
    throw new Error("useClock must be used within a ClockProvider");
  }

  const state = useSyncExternalStore<ClockState>(
    store.subscribe,
    store.getState,
    store.getState,
  );

  const activeFragrance = useMemo(
    () => getFragranceBySlug(state.fragranceSlug),
    [state.fragranceSlug],
  );

  return {
    hour: state.hour,
    fragranceSlug: state.fragranceSlug,
    activeFragrance,
    setHour: store.setHour,
    setFragranceSlug: store.setFragranceSlug,
    store,
  };
}
]]>

<![CDATA["use client";

import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from "react";
import { useClock } from "./ClockProvider";
import { calculateTierLevels, getDominantTier } from "./evaporation";
import { Flacon } from "./Flacon";
import { Scrubber } from "./Scrubber";
import { NotePyramid } from "./NotePyramid";
import { FragranceSwitch } from "./FragranceSwitch";

export function DryDown({ className = "" }: { className?: string }) {
  const { hour, setHour, fragranceSlug, setFragranceSlug, activeFragrance } =
    useClock();

  const levels = calculateTierLevels(activeFragrance.notes, hour);
  const dominantTier = getDominantTier(activeFragrance.notes, hour);

  // Polite announcement only when dominant tier changes
  const prevTierRef = useRef(dominantTier);
  const [announcement, setAnnouncement] = useState("");

  useEffect(() => {
    if (prevTierRef.current !== dominantTier) {
      setAnnouncement(
        `At ${Math.round(hour)} hours, the ${dominantTier} notes now lead ${activeFragrance.title}.`,
      );
      prevTierRef.current = dominantTier;
    }
  }, [dominantTier, hour, activeFragrance.title]);

  return (
    <div className={`w-full flex flex-col justify-between h-full ${className}`}>
      {/* Screen-reader polite live region */}
      <div aria-live="polite" aria-atomic="true" className="vr-vh">
        {announcement}
      </div>

      {/* Header of the Dry-Down stage */}
      <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-end justify-between gap-4 mb-6 border-b border-[color-mix(in_srgb,var(--color-calcaire)_20%,transparent)] pb-4">
        <div>
          <span className="vr-mono text-xs text-[var(--color-gilt)] block mb-1">
            § 02 — The Laboratory Stage
          </span>
          <h2 className="vr-serif text-3xl sm:text-4xl text-[var(--color-calcaire)] m-0 font-normal">
            {activeFragrance.title} —{" "}
            <em className="text-[var(--color-gilt)] not-italic font-normal">
              {activeFragrance.subtitle}
            </em>
          </h2>
        </div>

        <FragranceSwitch
          activeSlug={fragranceSlug}
          onSelect={setFragranceSlug}
        />
      </div>

      {/* Main Body: Flacon + Pyramid */}
      <div
        id="drydown-panel"
        role="tabpanel"
        aria-labelledby={`drydown-tab-${fragranceSlug}`}
        className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-8 items-center my-auto"
      >
        {/* Left Column: Architectural Flacon */}
        <div className="lg:col-span-5 flex flex-col items-center justify-center py-4">
          <Flacon levels={levels} height={380} />
          <p className="vr-mono text-[11px] text-[var(--color-veil)] opacity-90 mt-4 text-center">
            {activeFragrance.editionStamp} · {activeFragrance.macerationMonths} mo. oak
          </p>
        </div>

        {/* Right Column: Note Pyramid status */}
        <div className="lg:col-span-7 flex flex-col justify-center">
          <NotePyramid notes={activeFragrance.notes} hour={hour} />
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Bottom: Draggable Scrubber */}
      <div className="pt-6 border-t border-[color-mix(in_srgb,var(--color-calcaire)_20%,transparent)] mt-6">
        <Scrubber
          hour={hour}
          dominantTierName={dominantTier.toUpperCase()}
          onHourChange={setHour}
        />
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
]]>

<![CDATA[import { calculateTierLevels, type Note } from "./evaporation";

interface DryDownStripProps {
  notes: Note[];
  hour: number;
  className?: string;
  showLabels?: boolean;
}

export function DryDownStrip({
  notes,
  hour,
  className = "",
  showLabels = true,
}: DryDownStripProps) {
  const levels = calculateTierLevels(notes, hour);

  return (
    <div className={`flex flex-col gap-1.5 w-full ${className}`}>
      {showLabels && (
        <div className="flex justify-between vr-mono text-[10px] text-inherit opacity-90 font-medium">
          <span>Top ({Math.round(levels.top * 100)}%)</span>
          <span>Heart ({Math.round(levels.heart * 100)}%)</span>
          <span>Base ({Math.round(levels.base * 100)}%)</span>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* 3-segment bar */}
      <div className="h-2 w-full flex gap-1 bg-[color-mix(in_srgb,var(--color-ash)_25%,transparent)] p-0.5 border border-[color-mix(in_srgb,var(--color-ash)_35%,transparent)] rounded-full overflow-hidden">
        {/* Top segment */}
        <div
          className="h-full transition-all duration-200 rounded-sm"
          style={{
            flex: 1,
            backgroundColor: "var(--color-orris)",
            opacity: Math.max(0.15, levels.top),
          }}
        />
        {/* Heart segment */}
        <div
          className="h-full transition-all duration-200 rounded-sm"
          style={{
            flex: 1.2,
            backgroundColor: "var(--color-orris)",
            opacity: Math.max(0.15, levels.heart),
          }}
        />
        {/* Base segment */}
        <div
          className="h-full transition-all duration-200 rounded-sm"
          style={{
            flex: 1.4,
            backgroundColor: "var(--color-orris)",
            opacity: Math.max(0.15, levels.base),
          }}
        />
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

    <file path="src/app/(verane)/verane/drydown/evaporation.ts">
<![CDATA[export type OlfactoryTier = "top" | "heart" | "base";

export type NoteState = "emerging" | "present" | "fading" | "gone";

export interface Note {
  name: string;
  tier: OlfactoryTier;
  onset: number; // hour fully present (e.g. 0, 0.3)
  fade: number; // hour starts to dissipate
  gone: number; // hour completely evaporated
  description: string;
}

export interface NoteCalculated {
  intensity: number; // 0..1
  remaining: number; // 0..1
  state: NoteState;
}

export interface TierLevels {
  top: number;
  heart: number;
  base: number;
}

/** Calculate the instant intensity, remaining volume, and state of a note at a given hour. */
export function calculateNoteState(note: Note, hour: number): NoteCalculated {
  const h = Math.max(0, hour);
  const { onset, fade, gone } = note;

  // Remaining (in flacon/on skin): 1 until fade, linearly 0 at gone
  let remaining = 1;
  if (h <= fade) {
    remaining = 1;
  } else if (h >= gone) {
    remaining = 0;
  } else {
    remaining = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, 1 - (h - fade) / (gone - fade)));
  }

  // Intensity (olfactory prominence):
  let intensity = 0;
  let state: NoteState = "present";

  if (h >= gone) {
    intensity = 0;
    state = "gone";
  } else if (h >= fade) {
    intensity = remaining;
    state = "fading";
  } else if (h < onset) {
    state = "emerging";
    const rampDuration = Math.min(onset, 0.5);
    if (rampDuration > 0 && h >= onset - rampDuration) {
      intensity = (h - (onset - rampDuration)) / rampDuration;
    } else {
      intensity = 0;
    }
  } else {
    intensity = 1;
    state = "present";
  }

  return {
    intensity: Math.max(0, Math.min(1, intensity)),
    remaining: Math.max(0, Math.min(1, remaining)),
    state,
  };
}

/** Calculate the liquid levels across the three flacon tiers (top, heart, base). */
export function calculateTierLevels(notes: Note[], hour: number): TierLevels {
  const levels: TierLevels = { top: 0, heart: 0, base: 0 };

  for (const tier of ["top", "heart", "base"] as const) {
    const tierNotes = notes.filter((n) => n.tier === tier);
    if (tierNotes.length === 0) {
      levels[tier] = 0;
    } else {
      let maxRemaining = 0;
      for (const n of tierNotes) {
        const { remaining } = calculateNoteState(n, hour);
        if (remaining > maxRemaining) maxRemaining = remaining;
      }
      levels[tier] = maxRemaining;
    }
  }

  return levels;
}

/** Returns the dominant tier at the given hour. */
export function getDominantTier(notes: Note[], hour: number): OlfactoryTier {
  const intensities: Record<OlfactoryTier, number> = { top: 0, heart: 0, base: 0 };

  for (const n of notes) {
    const { intensity } = calculateNoteState(n, hour);
    intensities[n.tier] += intensity;
  }

  // Determine highest with tie-breaking top -> heart -> base
  let bestTier: OlfactoryTier = "top";
  let maxScore = intensities.top;

  if (intensities.heart > maxScore) {
    bestTier = "heart";
    maxScore = intensities.heart;
  }
  if (intensities.base > maxScore) {
    bestTier = "base";
  }

  return bestTier;
}
]]>
    </file>

<![CDATA[import type { TierLevels } from "./evaporation";

<![CDATA[import { calculateNoteState, type Note } from "./evaporation";
import { formatHour } from "./clock";

interface NotePyramidProps {
  notes: Note[];
  hour: number;
  className?: string;
}

export function NotePyramid({ notes, hour, className = "" }: NotePyramidProps) {
  return (
    <div className={`flex flex-col gap-3 ${className}`}>
      <div className="vr-mono text-xs opacity-85 text-[var(--color-calcaire)] pb-1 border-b border-[color-mix(in_srgb,var(--color-ash)_35%,transparent)]">
        Olfactory Pyramid &amp; Evaporation Status
      </div>

      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-3 gap-3">

          const tierNotes = notes.filter((n) => n.tier === tier);
          return (
            <div
              key={tier}
              className="p-3.5 border border-[color-mix(in_srgb,var(--color-ash)_25%,transparent)] bg-[color-mix(in_srgb,var(--color-calcaire)_4%,transparent)] flex flex-col justify-between rounded-xl"

                        {note.description}
                      </p>
                    </div>
                  );

              </div>
            </div>
          );
        })}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

    <file path="src/app/(verane)/verane/drydown/progress.ts">
<![CDATA[/**
 * Calculate progress (0..1) through a pinned section using its bounding client rect.
 *
 * @param rectTop - getBoundingClientRect().top of the outer section
 * @param rectHeight - offsetHeight or getBoundingClientRect().height of the outer section
 * @param windowHeight - window.innerHeight
 */
export function calculateScrollProgress(
  rectTop: number,
  rectHeight: number,
  windowHeight: number,
): number {
  const travel = rectHeight - windowHeight;
  if (travel <= 0) return 0;

  const scrolled = -rectTop;
  const progress = scrolled / travel;
  return Math.max(0, Math.min(1, progress));
}
]]>

<![CDATA["use client";

import type { KeyboardEvent } from "react";
import { formatHour, stepHour } from "./clock";

interface ScrubberProps {
  hour: number;
  dominantTierName?: string;
  onHourChange: (hour: number) => void;
  className?: string;
  id?: string;
}

export function Scrubber({
  hour,
  dominantTierName = "Top",
  onHourChange,
  className = "",
  id = "drydown-scrubber",
}: ScrubberProps) {
  const onKeyDown = (e: KeyboardEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
    switch (e.key) {
      case "ArrowLeft":
      case "ArrowDown":
        e.preventDefault();
        onHourChange(stepHour(hour, "prev15"));
        break;
      case "ArrowRight":
      case "ArrowUp":
        e.preventDefault();
        onHourChange(stepHour(hour, "next15"));
        break;
      case "PageDown":
        e.preventDefault();
        onHourChange(stepHour(hour, "prevHour"));
        break;
      case "PageUp":
        e.preventDefault();
        onHourChange(stepHour(hour, "nextHour"));
        break;
      case "Home":
        e.preventDefault();
        onHourChange(stepHour(hour, "start"));
        break;
      case "End":
        e.preventDefault();
        onHourChange(stepHour(hour, "end"));
        break;
    }
  };

  const formatted = formatHour(hour);
  const ariaValueText = `${formatted}, leading ${dominantTierName} notes`;

  return (
    <div className={`w-full flex flex-col ${className}`}>
      <div className="flex items-baseline justify-between">
        <label htmlFor={id} className="vr-mono text-xs opacity-90 text-[var(--color-calcaire)] cursor-pointer">
          Dry-Down Timeline
        </label>
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
          <span className="vr-mono text-xs opacity-90 text-[var(--color-calcaire)]">Dominant:</span>
          <span className="vr-mono text-xs font-semibold text-[var(--color-gilt)]">
            {dominantTierName}
          </span>
          <span className="vr-mono text-sm font-semibold tracking-wider ml-3 text-[var(--color-calcaire)]">
            {formatted}
          </span>
        </div>
      </div>

      <input
        id={id}
        type="range"
        min={0}
        max={12}
        step={0.05}
        value={hour}
        onChange={(e) => onHourChange(Number.parseFloat(e.target.value))}
        onKeyDown={onKeyDown}
        aria-valuemin={0}
        aria-valuemax={12}
        aria-valuenow={Math.round(hour * 10) / 10}
        aria-valuetext={ariaValueText}
        className="vr-range"
      />

      {/* Timeline markers */}
      <div className="flex justify-between vr-mono text-[11px] opacity-85 text-[var(--color-calcaire)] mt-1">
        <span>00:00 (Opening)</span>
        <span>03:00 (Heart)</span>
        <span>06:00 (Sillage)</span>
        <span>09:00 (Skin Musk)</span>
        <span>12:00 (Resin Base)</span>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
]]>
    </file>
    <file path="src/app/(verane)/verane/drydown/useStageMode.ts">
<![CDATA["use client";

import { useEffect, useState } from "react";

export type StageMode = "pinned" | "flow";

export function useStageMode(): StageMode {
  const [mode, setMode] = useState<StageMode>("flow");

  useEffect(() => {
    const mq = window.matchMedia(
      "(min-width: 900px) and (prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference)",
    );

    const update = () => {
      setMode(mq.matches ? "pinned" : "flow");
    };

    update();
    mq.addEventListener("change", update);
    return () => mq.removeEventListener("change", update);
  }, []);

  return mode;
}
]]>
    </file>

<![CDATA["use client";

import { useState, useRef, type FormEvent } from "react";
import {
  validateAppointment,
  type AppointmentFields,
  type AppointmentErrors,
} from "./validate-appointment";

export function AppointmentForm() {
  const [fields, setFields] = useState<AppointmentFields>({
    name: "",
    email: "",
    edition: "iris-calcaire",
    season: "printemps",
    guests: "1",
    notes: "",
  });

  const [errors, setErrors] = useState<AppointmentErrors>({});
  const [submitted, setSubmitted] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const nameInputRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);

  const handleSubmit = (e: FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    const foundErrors = validateAppointment(fields);
    setErrors(foundErrors);

    if (Object.keys(foundErrors).length > 0) {
      if (foundErrors.name) nameInputRef.current?.focus();
      return;
    }

    setSubmitted(
      `Your consultation request for ${fields.name} has been received. Our salon steward on Rue de l'Oratoire will respond with appointment ledger confirmation within two business days.`,
    );
  };

  if (submitted) {
    return (
      <div
        role="status"
        className="p-8 border border-[var(--color-gilt)] bg-[color-mix(in_srgb,var(--color-oud)_90%,var(--color-ash))] text-[var(--color-calcaire)] rounded-xl"
      >
        <div className="vr-mono text-xs text-[var(--color-gilt)] uppercase mb-2">
          Consultation Confirmed
        </div>
        <h3 className="vr-serif text-2xl sm:text-3xl font-normal mb-3">
          We await you in <em>Grasse.</em>
        </h3>
        <p className="font-light opacity-80 leading-relaxed mb-6">
          {submitted}
        </p>
        <button
          onClick={() => {
            setSubmitted(null);
            setFields({
              name: "",
              email: "",
              edition: "iris-calcaire",
              season: "printemps",
              guests: "1",
              notes: "",
            });
          }}
          className="vr-btn vr-btn--outline-dark"
        >
          Submit Another Request
        </button>
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <form
      onSubmit={handleSubmit}
      noValidate
      className="flex flex-col gap-6 text-[var(--color-calcaire)]"
    >
      {/* Name Field */}
      <div className="flex flex-col gap-1.5">
        <label htmlFor="app-name" className="vr-mono text-xs opacity-90">
          Full Name *
        </label>
        <input
          ref={nameInputRef}
          id="app-name"
          type="text"
          autoComplete="name"
          value={fields.name}
          onChange={(e) => {
            setFields((prev) => ({ ...prev, name: e.target.value }));
            if (errors.name) setErrors((prev) => ({ ...prev, name: undefined }));
          }}
          aria-invalid={errors.name ? "true" : undefined}
          aria-describedby={errors.name ? "name-error" : undefined}
          placeholder="e.g. Laurent Vianney"
          className="h-12 px-4 bg-transparent border border-[color-mix(in_srgb,var(--color-calcaire)_30%,transparent)] focus:border-[var(--color-gilt)] outline-none text-[var(--color-calcaire)] rounded-lg transition-colors duration-150"
        />
        {errors.name && (
          <span id="name-error" className="vr-mono text-xs text-[var(--color-gilt)] mt-0.5">
            {errors.name}
          </span>
        )}
      </div>

      {/* Email Field */}
      <div className="flex flex-col gap-1.5">
        <label htmlFor="app-email" className="vr-mono text-xs opacity-90">
          Email Address *
        </label>
        <input
          id="app-email"
          type="email"
          autoComplete="email"
          value={fields.email}
          onChange={(e) => {
            setFields((prev) => ({ ...prev, email: e.target.value }));
            if (errors.email) setErrors((prev) => ({ ...prev, email: undefined }));
          }}
          aria-invalid={errors.email ? "true" : undefined}
          aria-describedby={errors.email ? "email-error" : undefined}
          placeholder="laurent@example.com"
          className="h-12 px-4 bg-transparent border border-[color-mix(in_srgb,var(--color-calcaire)_30%,transparent)] focus:border-[var(--color-gilt)] outline-none text-[var(--color-calcaire)] rounded-lg transition-colors duration-150"
        />
        {errors.email && (
          <span id="email-error" className="vr-mono text-xs text-[var(--color-gilt)] mt-0.5">
            {errors.email}
          </span>
        )}
      </div>

      {/* Fragrance Focus & Season in 2-col grid */}
      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 gap-6">
        <div className="flex flex-col gap-1.5">
          <label htmlFor="app-edition" className="vr-mono text-xs opacity-90">
            Fragrance or Consultation *
          </label>
          <select
            id="app-edition"
            value={fields.edition}
            onChange={(e) => {
              setFields((prev) => ({ ...prev, edition: e.target.value }));
              if (errors.edition) setErrors((prev) => ({ ...prev, edition: undefined }));
            }}
            className="h-12 px-3 bg-[var(--color-oud)] border border-[color-mix(in_srgb,var(--color-calcaire)_30%,transparent)] focus:border-[var(--color-gilt)] outline-none text-[var(--color-calcaire)] rounded-lg transition-colors duration-150"
          >
            <option value="premiere-heure">Nº 1 Première Heure</option>
            <option value="iris-calcaire">Nº 2 Iris Calcaire</option>
            <option value="fumee-lente">Nº 3 Fumée Lente</option>
            <option value="nuit-doratoire">Nº 4 Nuit d&apos;Oratoire</option>
            <option value="bespoke-organ">The Organ Bespoke Consultation</option>
            <option value="full-quadriptych">Complete Four-Flacon Tasting</option>
          </select>
        </div>

        <div className="flex flex-col gap-1.5">
          <label htmlFor="app-season" className="vr-mono text-xs opacity-90">
            Preferred Season *
          </label>
          <select
            id="app-season"
            value={fields.season}
            onChange={(e) => {
              setFields((prev) => ({ ...prev, season: e.target.value }));
              if (errors.season) setErrors((prev) => ({ ...prev, season: undefined }));
            }}
            className="h-12 px-3 bg-[var(--color-oud)] border border-[color-mix(in_srgb,var(--color-calcaire)_30%,transparent)] focus:border-[var(--color-gilt)] outline-none text-[var(--color-calcaire)] rounded-lg transition-colors duration-150"
          >
            <option value="printemps">Printemps (March – May)</option>
            <option value="ete">Été (June – August)</option>
            <option value="automne">Automne (September – November)</option>
            <option value="hiver">Hiver (December – February)</option>
          </select>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Guest count & Optional notes */}
      <div className="flex flex-col gap-1.5">
        <label htmlFor="app-guests" className="vr-mono text-xs opacity-90">
          Consultation Party
        </label>
        <select
          id="app-guests"
          value={fields.guests}
          onChange={(e) => setFields((prev) => ({ ...prev, guests: e.target.value }))}
          className="h-12 px-3 bg-[var(--color-oud)] border border-[color-mix(in_srgb,var(--color-calcaire)_30%,transparent)] focus:border-[var(--color-gilt)] outline-none text-[var(--color-calcaire)] rounded-lg transition-colors duration-150"
        >
          <option value="1">Individual Consultation (1 guest, 90 minutes)</option>
          <option value="2">Paired Consultation (2 guests, 120 minutes)</option>
        </select>
      </div>

      <div className="flex flex-col gap-1.5">
        <label htmlFor="app-notes" className="vr-mono text-xs opacity-90">
          Specific Notes or Olfactory Sensitivities (Optional)
        </label>
        <textarea

          onChange={(e) => setFields((prev) => ({ ...prev, notes: e.target.value }))}
          placeholder="Mention any particular materials, memories, or bespoke accord desires..."

        />
      </div>

      <button type="submit" className="vr-btn vr-btn--orris w-full mt-2">
        Request Appointment at the Salon
      </button>

      <p className="vr-mono text-[10px] opacity-90 text-center m-0">
        40 Rue de l&apos;Oratoire · Grasse, France · By Appointment Only
      </p>
    </form>
  );
}

    <file path="src/app/(verane)/verane/forms/validate-appointment.ts">
<![CDATA[const EMAIL_REGEX = /^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]+$/;

export interface AppointmentFields {
  name: string;
  email: string;
  edition: string;
  season: string;
  guests: string;
  notes?: string;
}

export type AppointmentErrors = {
  name?: string;
  email?: string;
  edition?: string;
  season?: string;
};

/** Validate the private salon appointment form. Pure validation function. */
export function validateAppointment(fields: AppointmentFields): AppointmentErrors {
  const errors: AppointmentErrors = {};

  if (!fields.name || fields.name.trim().length === 0) {
    errors.name = "Please provide your name";
  }

  if (!fields.email || !EMAIL_REGEX.test(fields.email.trim())) {
    errors.email = "Please provide a valid email";
  }

  if (!fields.edition || fields.edition.trim().length === 0) {
    errors.edition = "Please select an edition or consultation";
  }

  if (!fields.season || fields.season.trim().length === 0) {
    errors.season = "Please select a preferred season";
  }

  return errors;
}
]]>
    </file>

      },

    {

      shortName: "Benjoin",
      origin: "Laos",
      tier: "base",

        name: "Benjoin",
        tier: "base",
        onset: 1.2,
        fade: 9.0,
        gone: 15.5,
        description: "Almond-scented crystalline balsam tears with warm vanilla glaze",
      },
    },
  ],
};

export function getOrganVial(tier: OlfactoryTier, id: string): OrganVial {
  const shelf = ORGAN_SHELVES[tier];
  return shelf.find((v) => v.id === id) ?? shelf[0];
}

/** Compute derived blend composition based on the 3 chosen vials. */
export function deriveBespokeBlend(
  topId: string,
  heartId: string,
  baseId: string,
): BespokeBlend {
  const topVial = getOrganVial("top", topId);
  const heartVial = getOrganVial("heart", heartId);
  const baseVial = getOrganVial("base", baseId);

  const topIdx = ORGAN_SHELVES.top.findIndex((v) => v.id === topVial.id) + 1;
  const heartIdx = ORGAN_SHELVES.heart.findIndex((v) => v.id === heartVial.id) + 1;
  const baseIdx = ORGAN_SHELVES.base.findIndex((v) => v.id === baseVial.id) + 1;

  const batchCode = `B-${topIdx.toString().padStart(2, "0")}${heartIdx}${baseIdx}`;
  const title = `${topVial.shortName} · ${heartVial.shortName} · ${baseVial.shortName}`;

  // Longevity estimation
  const maxGone = Math.max(topVial.note.gone, heartVial.note.gone, baseVial.note.gone);
  const longevity = `Lasts past ${Math.floor(maxGone)} h on skin`;
  const formula = `${topVial.origin} + ${heartVial.origin} + ${baseVial.origin}`;

  return {
    title,
    batchCode,
    notes: [topVial.note, heartVial.note, baseVial.note],
    longevity,
    formula,
  };
}
]]>

<![CDATA["use client";

import { useState } from "react";
import {
  ORGAN_SHELVES,
  deriveBespokeBlend,
  type OrganVial,
} from "./organ";
import { useClock } from "../drydown/ClockProvider";
import { DryDownStrip } from "../drydown/DryDownStrip";
import { Scrubber } from "../drydown/Scrubber";
import { getDominantTier } from "../drydown/evaporation";

export function OrganComposer() {
  const [topId, setTopId] = useState("t1");
  const [heartId, setHeartId] = useState("h1");
  const [baseId, setBaseId] = useState("b1");

  const { hour, setHour } = useClock();

  const blend = deriveBespokeBlend(topId, heartId, baseId);
  const dominantTier = getDominantTier(blend.notes, hour);

  return (
    <div className="w-full grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-8 items-start">
      {/* Left: The Shelves (8 cols) */}
      <div className="lg:col-span-8 flex flex-col gap-8">
        {(["top", "heart", "base"] as const).map((tier) => {
          const vials = ORGAN_SHELVES[tier];
          const selectedId =
            tier === "top" ? topId : tier === "heart" ? heartId : baseId;
          const setSelected =
            tier === "top" ? setTopId : tier === "heart" ? setHeartId : setBaseId;

          return (
            <div key={tier} className="flex flex-col gap-3">
              <div className="flex justify-between items-baseline border-b border-[var(--rule-color)] pb-2">
                <span className="vr-mono text-xs font-semibold uppercase text-[var(--color-ash)]">
                  Tier {tier === "top" ? "I" : tier === "heart" ? "II" : "III"} —{" "}
                  {tier} Shelf
                </span>
                <span className="vr-mono text-[11px] text-[var(--color-ash)] font-medium">
                  Select 1 raw distillation
                </span>
              </div>

              <div
                role="radiogroup"
                aria-label={`${tier} tier raw materials`}
                className="grid grid-cols-2 sm:grid-cols-5 gap-2.5"
              >
                {vials.map((vial: OrganVial) => {
                  const isChecked = vial.id === selectedId;
                  return (
                    <button
                      key={vial.id}
                      role="radio"
                      aria-checked={isChecked}
                      onClick={() => setSelected(vial.id)}
                      className="vr-organ-vial"
                    >
                      {/* Stylized vial drop icon */}
                      <svg
                        viewBox="0 0 24 24"
                        width="18"
                        height="18"
                        className="mb-1.5 opacity-90"
                        aria-hidden="true"
                      >
                        <path
                          d="M12 3C10 7 6 12 6 16a6 6 0 0 0 12 0c0-4-4-9-6-13Z"
                          fill={isChecked ? "currentColor" : "none"}
                          stroke="currentColor"
                          strokeWidth="1.5"
                        />
                      </svg>
                      <span className="text-xs font-medium leading-tight">
                        {vial.shortName}
                      </span>
                      <span className="vr-mono text-[9px] mt-1 block">
                        {vial.origin.split(",")[0]}
                      </span>
                    </button>
                  );
                })}
              </div>
            </div>
          );
        })}
      </div>

      {/* Right: Derived Blend Result Card (4 cols) */}
      <div className="lg:col-span-4 vr-card sticky top-24 bg-[var(--color-calcaire)] rounded-2xl">
        <div>
          <div className="flex justify-between items-center mb-4 pb-3 border-b border-[var(--rule-color)]">
            <span className="vr-mono text-xs font-semibold text-[var(--color-oud)]">
              Formulation Ledger
            </span>
            <span className="vr-stamp rounded-md">{blend.batchCode}</span>
          </div>

          <p className="vr-mono text-[11px] text-[var(--color-ash)] font-medium mb-1">Bespoke Accord</p>
          <h3 className="vr-serif text-2xl mb-2 font-normal text-[var(--color-oud)]">
            <em>{blend.title}</em>
          </h3>
          <p className="text-sm text-[var(--color-ash)] font-light mb-4">
            {blend.formula}
          </p>

          <div className="vr-mono text-xs text-[var(--color-ash)] mb-3">
            {blend.longevity}
          </div>

          {/* Mini dry-down strip responding to the clock */}
          <div className="my-5 p-3.5 bg-[var(--color-veil)] border border-[color-mix(in_srgb,var(--color-ash)_25%,transparent)] rounded-xl">
            <span className="vr-mono text-[10px] block mb-2 text-[var(--color-oud)] font-medium">
              Accord Dry-Down at {hour.toFixed(1)}h
            </span>
            <DryDownStrip notes={blend.notes} hour={hour} />
          </div>

          {/* Mini scrubber to test the bespoke blend */}
          <Scrubber
            hour={hour}
            dominantTierName={dominantTier.toUpperCase()}
            onHourChange={setHour}
            id="organ-scrubber"
            className="mb-4"
          />
        </div>

        <div className="pt-4 border-t border-[var(--rule-color)] mt-4">
          <a
            href="#appointment"
            className="vr-btn vr-btn--orris w-full text-center"
          >
            Inquire About This Blend
          </a>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
]]>

                  <th className="py-3 px-4 font-normal">Key Terroir</th>
                  <th className="py-3 px-4 font-normal">Bottling</th>
                  <th className="py-3 px-4 font-normal">Allocation</th>
                  <th className="py-3 pl-4 font-normal">Status</th>

              </thead>
              <tbody className="divide-y divide-[var(--rule-color)] font-light text-[var(--color-oud)]">

                  <tr key={entry.edition} className="hover:bg-[color-mix(in_srgb,var(--color-veil)_50%,transparent)]">

                    <td className="py-4 px-4">{entry.bottledDate}</td>
                    <td className="py-4 px-4 vr-mono text-xs">{entry.flacons} btl</td>

                        {entry.status}

                    </td>

            </table>

          <Picture
            assetKey="iris-fields"
            alt="Terraced iris fields in Grasse morning mist"
            className="w-full h-full object-cover"
          />
          <div className="absolute bottom-4 left-4 sm:bottom-8 sm:left-8 bg-[var(--color-oud)] border border-[color-mix(in_srgb,var(--color-ash)_40%,transparent)] px-4 py-2 sm:px-6 sm:py-3 text-[var(--color-calcaire)] rounded-xl">

            <span className="vr-serif text-sm sm:text-base">
              Dawn harvest of <em>Iris pallida</em> · Collines de Grasse

          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </section>
  );
}

    <file path="src/app/(verane)/verane/sections/DryDownSection.tsx">
<![CDATA["use client";

import { useEffect, useRef } from "react";
import { useClock } from "../drydown/ClockProvider";
import { useStageMode } from "../drydown/useStageMode";
import { calculateScrollProgress } from "../drydown/progress";
import { progressToHour } from "../drydown/clock";
import { DryDown } from "../drydown/DryDown";

export function DryDownSection() {
  const outerRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const { setHour } = useClock();
  const mode = useStageMode();

  useEffect(() => {
    if (mode !== "pinned") return;

    let ticking = false;

    const handleScroll = () => {
      if (!ticking) {
        window.requestAnimationFrame(() => {
          if (!outerRef.current) return;
          const rect = outerRef.current.getBoundingClientRect();
          const winH = window.innerHeight;

          // Only drive clock when section is actively within the pinned scroll envelope
          if (rect.top <= 0 && rect.bottom >= winH) {
            const progress = calculateScrollProgress(rect.top, rect.height, winH);
            const hour = progressToHour(progress);
            setHour(hour);
          }
          ticking = false;
        });
        ticking = true;
      }
    };

    window.addEventListener("scroll", handleScroll, { passive: true });
    return () => window.removeEventListener("scroll", handleScroll);
  }, [mode, setHour]);

  return (
    <section
      id="drydown"
      ref={outerRef}
      data-mode={mode}
      className="vr-drydown-outer vr-dark"
    >
      <div className="vr-drydown-stage">
        <DryDown />
      </div>
    </section>
  );
}
]]>
    </file>

}

<![CDATA["use client";

import { useClock } from "../drydown/ClockProvider";
import { formatHour } from "../drydown/clock";
import { calculateTierLevels } from "../drydown/evaporation";
import { LogoMark } from "../brand/Logo";

export function Header() {
  const { hour, activeFragrance } = useClock();
  const levels = calculateTierLevels(activeFragrance.notes, hour);

  return (
    <header className="sticky top-0 z-40 w-full h-[var(--topbar-h)] bg-[color-mix(in_srgb,var(--color-calcaire)_94%,transparent)] backdrop-blur-md border-b border-[var(--rule-color)] transition-colors duration-200">

          aria-label="Maison Vérane — Return to top"
        >
          <LogoMark
            size={28}
            topLevel={levels.top}
            heartLevel={levels.heart}
            baseLevel={levels.base}
            className="transition-transform duration-200 group-hover:scale-105"
          />
          <div className="flex flex-col">
            <span className="vr-mono text-[9px] tracking-[0.25em] leading-none opacity-85">

            <em className="text-[var(--color-orris)] not-italic font-normal">
              turning seasons.
            </em>
          </h2>

          <p className="text-lg font-light leading-relaxed text-[var(--color-ash)]">

            formulate exactly four editions in batches of four hundred numbered bottles.
            Once an edition is claimed, the formula is catalogued and retired into the cellar vault.

        {/* 4 Fragrance Cards Grid */}
        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-6">
          {FRAGRANCES.map((fragrance) => (
            <FragranceCard key={fragrance.slug} fragrance={fragrance} />
          ))}
        </div>
      </div>
    </section>
  );
}
